# Golden Liquid cases excluded from TestGoldenLiquidParse and
# TestGoldenLiquidRender, one per line: <case name><TAB><reason><TAB><note>.
# The reason is one of ADR-010 D4 item 7's closed set; a dialect line names
# its ADR-004 item. A case the parse refuses is excluded at parse, and must
# still be refused there; a case that parses is excluded at render, and must
# not render its expected result.
blank and empty, undefined is equal to blank	dialect	ADR-004 D6 item 1: a name bound by nothing is template.undefined_variable; this case is lax mode's, rendering it as nothing
blank and empty, undefined is not equal to empty	dialect	ADR-004 D6 item 1: a name bound by nothing is template.undefined_variable; this case is lax mode's, rendering it as nothing
